items.label: colour
items.meaning: 7月6日文章称，华尔街分析师预计今年剩余时间英伟达收入增长82%，2027年增长41%；均为预测。
items.quote: For the rest of this year, they expect 82% growth. For 2027, that figure rises to 41%.
items.why: 可作为收入增长预期的参考，但文章未交代分析师样本或财年口径；原文还将82%至41%称为上升，不能直接用作FY2027收入预测。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 7月6日文章称，分析师平均预计英伟达截至2028年1月的FY2028每股收益为12.76美元。
items.quote: For fiscal 2028, ending January 2028, the average analyst projects $12.76 in earnings per share.
items.why: 是中期估值的辅助参考，但属于下一财年的预测，不是FY2027已报告利润，文章也未说明共识样本。

items.label: core
items.meaning: 7月18日报道称，SK海力士预计2027年将是内存短缺最严重的一年，短缺将持续至2030年。
items.quote: SK hynix, one of the big three memory chip manufacturers, even says that 2027 is set to be the “worst year” for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
items.why: 持续的内存供需压力可能影响英伟达产品供应和成本；文章同时报道RTX 50 Super因GDDR7价格而暂缓。不过这是供应商对整体短缺的预测，不能据此断定具体发布时间或毛利。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 7月22日，BofA转述AMD的模型估计：在100kW部署中，EPYC 9965机架吞吐量约为Vera基准的2.4倍；下一代EPYC 6预计约为3.3倍。
items.quote: AMD estimates its EPYC 9965 (Turin) chip delivers approximately 2.4x the rack-level throughput of NVIDIA's Vera baseline in a modeled 100kW deployment, with the next-generation EPYC 6 (Venice) projected to extend that advantage to roughly 3.3x total throughput, according to BofA's characterization of AMD's own estimates.
items.why: 有助于评估Vera面临的CPU竞争，但数字来自AMD模型，下一代结果还是预测；吞吐量也不能涵盖文章所述的延迟和系统整合优势。

items.label: exclude
items.meaning: 7月2日报道称，四家公司将面临合计八项虚假陈述欺诈指控，拟于7月6日公布；涉案服务器可能含英伟达先进AI芯片，最终目的地未明。
items.quote: The four companies will also face a total of eight charges of fraud by false representation which are due to be announced on July 6. ... Authorities say that the servers in question, which may have contained advanced Nvidia AI chips, were shipped from Singapore to Malaysia.
items.why: 这是针对第三方的欺诈指控，芯片类型和最终目的地均未确定；没有显示英伟达涉案，也不能回答中国是否允许H200销售。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 7月24日，英伟达与微软、Meta等科技公司联名呼吁政策制定者避免过早限制开放权重AI模型；黄仁勋也转发了信件。
items.quote: Nvidia , Microsoft , Meta , Palantir and more than 20 other companies released a letter Friday urging policymakers to avoid "premature restrictions" on open-weight artificial intelligence models that would "stifle competition or drive innovation overseas."
items.why: 值得记录英伟达在可能影响AI生态的政策辩论中的立场，但联名信不是政府政策决定。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 文章称，7月21日美国财长贝森特表示，特朗普政府将研究中国公司是否窃取美国知识产权，并称政府有能力因此实施制裁。
items.quote: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday that the Trump administration would look into whether Chinese companies were stealing American intellectual property, and stated that the government has "the ability to sanction them because of this theft."
items.why: 显示对华AI政策风险，但只是研究和制裁能力表态，并非已有窃取结论、制裁或芯片出口新规。

items.label: exclude
items.meaning: 文章称，7月22日白宫顾问Michael Kratsios表示，中国Moonshot AI通过蒸馏Anthropic技术开发Kimi K3。
items.quote: White House advisor Michael Kratsios on Wednesday said that China's Moonshot AI developed its Kimi K3 model by distilling Anthropic's technology.
items.why: 这是关于第三方模型开发方式的表态，本身未证明违法或宣布政策措施，也未直接涉及英伟达芯片或财务表现。

items.label: core
items.meaning: 7月6日文章称，管理层在最近一次季度电话会上预计，超大规模云厂商支出2026年将达6500亿美元，2027年将超过1万亿美元；两者均为预测。
items.quote: During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after reaching a projected $650 billion in 2026.
items.why: 这一预测对AI基础设施需求和英伟达增长假设有重大参考价值，且与两期支出问题相关；但文章未明确限定为四大厂或仅限数据中心资本开支。
